result.title: Widening Harm Evaluation Coverage with a Judge that Reads the World
result.summary: An agent acting in a stateful environment can leave evidence of harm in two places: the record of what it did and said, or the world it changed. Safety evaluations for discovering harm examine one or the other in limited ways, using either an LLM judge over the trajectory or deterministic checks over the final state. Although LLM-based verifiers that inspect the environment exist, they have been used to verify task completion, not to detect and confirm harm in a safety setting. We address this gap with an LLM that has read-only access to the environment state and is given a harm taxonomy. We evaluate this approach in three environments: two from DecodingTrust-Arena and one from OSWorld. We hold the judge model and harm taxonomy fixed, varying only what the judge observes: the trajectory, read-only tools for inspecting the environment, or both channels together. In the two DecodingTrust-Arena environments, combining the trajectory and state-only judges recalls 94 percent of confirmed harms, compared with 53 percent for the trajectory judge alone. On OS-Harm, the union recalls 77 percent, compared with 67 percent. A single judge given both channels does not perform better and produces more false negatives than the state-only judge. We also record disagreements and find that the two channels miss different episodes. These results suggest that combining verdicts from two channel-specific judges is a robust and flexible approach to detecting and verifying harm in agentic settings.

AI.brief_summary: 论文让 LLM 判官以只读方式检视 Agent 运行的环境状态并结合危害分类体系，在三个环境中固定判官与分类，仅改变其可观察通道（轨迹、状态、二者合并），比较对已确认危害的召回，发现两通道漏检不同片段，合并两个专用判官的判决优于单一双通道判官。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「固定判官、只消融可观察证据通道」的评测设计与通道间不一致分析，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与内部推理状态如何分工融合，以及取证充分性与停止判断的设定方式。
